input_manifest.source: PDG 2024 Review of Particle Physics + pdgLive verification
input_manifest.confidence_convention: 1-sigma Gaussian for Monte Carlo; see per-quark notes
input_manifest.scale_notes: Light quarks (u,d,s): MS-bar at 2 GeV. Charm: MS-bar at m_c scale (~1.27 GeV). Bottom: MS-bar at m_b scale (~4.18 GeV). Top: pole mass from cross-section measurements. These are NOT at a common scale. Zenczykowski frames the phase discussion at 'low energy'. A scale-consistent test requires QCD running to a common scale. Results are CONDITIONAL on the mixed-scale assumption.

Q1_units.check: sqrt(m_j) = sqrt(M) * (1 + sqrt(2)*k*cos(...)) — sqrt(mass) = sqrt(mass) * dimensionless
Q1_units.notes: Dimensionally consistent. M in MeV, k and delta dimensionless.

Q2_inputs.check: All inputs from PDG 2024 with declared scheme, scale, and confidence convention.
Q2_inputs.notes: Mixed-scale inputs explicitly declared in INPUT_MANIFEST. Light quarks: MS-bar at 2 GeV, 90% CL converted to 1-sigma. Heavy quarks: MS-bar at own scale or pole mass, 1-sigma. No calibration or target selection reused. WARNING: mixed scales mean results are CONDITIONAL, not scale-consistent.

Q3_observable.observable: Best-fit phase delta_f for each sector (f=up, down) under Eq. (4)
Q3_observable.decision_threshold: No sigma-based falsification claim due to mixed-scale inputs. Report compatibility/tension qualitatively and with chi^2/p-values for fixed-phase fits. Do not claim 'falsification at N sigma'.
Q3_observable.notes: Following Codex D1 v3 audit: 'Treat any hierarchy tension as conditional unless the scale-consistent analysis justifies a stronger statement.' This run uses mixed-scale inputs, so all results are CONDITIONAL.

preflight.overall_notes: EXPLORATORY: may run sensitivity/diagnostic work but cannot produce prediction, sigma, or public language per Codex formula-readiness gate. Results are conditional on mixed-scale assumption.

regression_test.notes: Free fit gives delta_U = 0.074533 rad. Zenczykowski predicts 0.074074 rad. Difference: 0.000459 rad (0.62%). Fixed-delta chi^2 = 4.4978 (p = 0.0339). Tension at 95% CL.

claim_boundary: No falsification claim. No sigma-based claim. Results conditional on mixed-scale inputs. Scale-consistent test requires QCD running.
